mutations.name: projection lint finds nothing
kills: registry lints a dependent reading a field outside its producer's projection fails the projection lint

mutations.name: observed lint accepts a bare observed fact
kills: registry lints an observed fact with neither a producer kind nor a TTL fails

mutations.name: observed lint accepts any producer kind
kills: registry lints an observed fact whose producer names a kind no source emits fails

mutations.name: long-claims lint accepts every claim
kills: registry lints a long-scope claim outside a start set fails, and the same claim in a start set passes

mutations.name: fact-entry lint accepts a missing body
kills: registry lints a fact entry with an empty projection or a missing body fails
